description: Get the exact SPF, DKIM and DMARC DNS records to publish for a domain. $1 USDC on Base per call. Reads live MX, NS, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, detects the mail provider and DNS host, and returns records in order (create, replace or keep) with one merged SPF and a staged DMARC policy. Don't use this for testing a real sent message; use /v1/report. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
